simple.meaning: נָדַר (nâdar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to promise (pos., to do or give something to God).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 31 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 28:20. Its contexts include offering, Torah, priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָדַר (H5087).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָדַר (nâdar) / H5087 is traced through Genesis 28:20, Genesis 31:13, Leviticus 27:8, Numbers 6:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.

Perfect; Imperfect . 3 masculine singular יִדֹּר Num 6:21 5 t.; 2 masculine singular תִּדֹּר Deut 12:17 4 t., תִּדּוֺר Eccl 5:4 4 t.
